summary: 10.0.36.05 Desktop Parity & User-Friendly Errors: Sales & Purchase Register Import Studio Parity with Charges & Calculations, Database Constraints & Error Propagation in ApiExceptionHandler, and UI Badge Sync
highlights: 1. Sales & Purchase Register Import Studio Parity: Added document charge parsing (charge_1_..., charge_2_..., additional_charges), matching Desktop DocumentCalculationEngine and ImportDocumentPolicy.
2. Canonical Document Calculation Engine: Calculates item taxable, line tax, charge amounts, taxable charges, and charge GST matching Desktop down to the exact penny.

3. Mandatory Database Constraint & Snapshot Parity: Populated sameAsBilling: true, dueDate from payment terms, master billing/delivery addresses and GSTIN snapshots, total quantity, and canonical APPROVED documentStatus.

4. User-Friendly Backend Server Error Propagation: Added specific exception handlers in ApiExceptionHandler for DataIntegrityViolationException, HttpMessageNotReadableException, and MethodArgumentNotValidException, returning root cause details instead of masked generic error.
5. ApiService Error Enhancement: Surfaces backend error details and field validation lists directly in modal dialogs.
6. Version & Cache-Buster Synchronization: Updated static HTML version tags (lines 202, 204, 544, 654) and script cache-buster query parameters to 10.0.36.05 across index.html.
